I loved math, though I wasn’t always great at it and I loved English, though I hated writing papers 😂 I’m horrid at basic math but I’m great with algebra, calculus and trig. Not sure why but they make more sense to me. In college I took things I had to take. There were not a whole lot of options so it was all things I didn’t like anyway but they made easy As. I only took two years of college. I tried to go back but they denied my financial aid this past January.

I use to enjoy it. Helping people. It was humbling but now I just don’t want anything to do with customer service. I can’t go back to school until I pay a semester worth out of pocket (no funding) due to getting my aid denied. I wish I could but honestly I don’t know what I would go for anyway. We’re kind of in a pickle. My husband is the only income. I’m half way through the pregnancy plus a baby at home and no help so me working is kind of not an option. At least not outside the home. Problem is finances. We don’t make enough to pay our bills and my husband has the best job in our area and makes really great money with great benefits. We just made a lot of mistakes with loans are credit cards so we’re paying all that off while trying to survive. This is why I feel so guilty and want to do something besides be a stay at home mom.
Coffee is totally fine anyway! You just have to learn how to limit your daily amount. I drink pop all the dang time.
NTA - she sounds like a spoiled person. I rolled my eyes so hard reading this that they about come out of my head! Lol
